description:
crate-jmap-metadata-types/tests/metadata_types.rs:195 triggers clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args under cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings:

    let round_trip = serde_json::to_value(&Metadata::Annotation(ann)).unwrap();
                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Fix is mechanical: drop the leading & to pass by value.

Introduced 2026-05-16 by ad2a6e0 (fix(metadata-types): model relatedType as Option<String> for §4.1 partial responses). It does NOT trip the standard workspace pre-commit gate (`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`) because that gate omits --all-targets; the warning is in a test file.

This finding surfaced incidentally while completing /do-beads JMAP-wzq9 (metadata-CLIENT review); the issue is in metadata-TYPES, not metadata-client, so it belongs under the metadata-types review epic JMAP-b3wp.

P3 (clippy-level, test-only, mechanical fix). Engineering basis: a future contributor running --all-targets locally or in CI will hit a hard error from -D warnings; the workspace gate's lack of --all-targets is a separate concern (deciding whether to widen the gate is a workspace-policy bead, not this one).
title: test: needless borrow on Metadata::Annotation under --all-targets clippy
